verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for email marketing platforms, since self-hostable alternatives exist, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Mailchimp's core marketing product can be self-hosted; the API endpoints shown are Mailchimp-hosted (api.mailchimp.com). Open source Open Commerce is a separate product, and moving to Mautic with one's own SMTP server is a user switching to another tool, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
